subject: Audit logs / KMS / Residency — pricing options & discount request
messages:
From: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@mercuryhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>; Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@hcpsystems.com>
Cc: procurement@mercuryhealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-ons: audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency — pricing request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the call earlier. Procurement asked me to get formal pricing and packaging for a few compliance/security items we need to include in our SOW with Redwood:

- Audit log exports: daily export + long-term retention (7 years). Please provide per-month cost for 30/90/365/7yr retention tiers, and indicate if there are per-export bandwidth or API charge assumptions.
- Key management: native Redwood KMS vs BYOK (customer-managed HSM). If you support HSM (Azure Key Vault / CloudHSM) pass-through, list one-time integration and per-key monthly fees.
- Data residency: we need EU (Frankfurt) and Canada residency options. Price for dedicated residency vs soft-residency (geo-routing).
- HIPAA: a one-page mapping of controls and a price for the HIPAA add-on including Business Associate Agreement (BAA) - any one-time legal fees?

We are evaluating two purchase options: 12-month reserved commit (with a spend MRR) or usage-commit + volume discounts. Can you include suggested discounting tiers (e.g., commit levels) and any onboarding credit you can offer? Our target decision window is 2 weeks (by Aug 17).

Please include a succinct spreadsheet or PDF attachment. Happy to set a quick follow-up if you prefer to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Anita Sharma
Head of Procurement, Mercury Health
[Mercury Health — procurement@mercuryhealth.com]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency — pricing request

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a compact pricing pack to get us started (Redwood_Compliance_AddOn_Pricing_v2.pdf). High level notes below — I can expand into a line-by-line spreadsheet if helpful.

Summary (high level)
- Audit logs (hosted export): base ingestion included in hosted API. Export + retention tiers: 30d ($0.03/GB/mo), 90d ($0.06/GB/mo), 365d ($0.14/GB/mo), 7yr ($0.40/GB/mo + archival storage fee). Exports delivered via S3/HTTPS; egress estimated at $0.01/GB unless cross-region replication required.
- KMS/HSM: two options:
  * Redwood-managed keys (standard): $500/month + $0.25/key/month for additional customer keys.
  * BYOK/HSM passthrough: one-time integration $15k (setup + attestation), then pass-through costs + $0.10/key/month admin fee. We can support AWS CloudHSM and Azure Key Vault HSM.
- Residency: soft-routing (geo-route) available at no recurring cost; fully dedicated residency (isolated tenant + dedicated db cluster) starts at $12k/month region.
- HIPAA: BAA included for Enterprise plans; one-time compliance onboarding ($8k) covers attestation and baseline controls mapping.

Discounting (initial): we can offer a volume discount schedule tied to committed spend: 10% @ $50k/mo, 20% @ $150k/mo, 30% @ $300k/mo. We also typically offer a first-year onboarding credit (one-time) of up to $10k on 12mo commitments.

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_AddOn_Pricing_v2.pdf (pricing grid + assumptions).

Can you share an estimated tokens/month and expected average audit log volume (GB/day)? That will let me produce a specific quote.

I copied Marissa (product/compliance) to support the HIPAA mapping and discounts.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Compliance_AddOn_Pricing_v2.pdf (PDF, 142KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>; Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>; Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Mercury - compliance pricing review + discount ask

Team — quick internal take before we send a formal proposal to Mercury:

Notes / risks
- 7-year retention is heavy; recommend archival tier w/ multi-region durability. We should cap egress and clearly call out restore charges.
- BYOK/HSM passthrough: integration cost is real (security review + attestation). Legal will want indemnities for key-management failures.
- Dedicated residency at $12k/mo may be flexible for mid-market; we can reduce to $9k/mo with a 12mo commitment and 20% uplift on support SLA.

Proposed commercial concessions to win (Mercury is strategic sector: health):
- Offer 25% off audit-log storage for first 12 months if they commit to 12 months reserved inference capacity.
- Waive the one-time $8k HIPAA onboarding fee if they sign a 12-month Reserved plan within 30 days.
- Reduce the BYOK integration fee to $9k (from $15k) for this deal; keep true HSM pass-through vetted by infra.

Action items
- Priyom: can you run margin calc for 25% audit-log promo and 9k BYOK fee? Put numbers in the pricing sheet link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cexample-pricing (owner: Marissa).
- Kimberly: prepare HIPAA one-pager and control mapping; I think we can deliver within 48 hours.

If internal OK, Jonas — send updated quote and DocuSign SOW.

-Marissa

[Internal: HubSpot: HS-2489 | CRM notes updated]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@hcpsystems.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated commercial: Mercury Health — compliance add-ons (proposal attached)

Hi Anita / Tom — following up with an updated proposal and pricing after our internal review. Key changes per our discussion:

- Audit logs: retained pricing per GB/month attached in the PDF across 30/90/365/7yr tiers. Offering a promotional 20% discount on audit-log storage for first 12 months if Mercury signs a 12-month reserved commitment (any region).
- BYOK / HSM: reduced one-time integration fee to $9,000 (from list $15k). Admin fee: $0.10/key/month.
- KMS (Redwood-managed): $450/month + $0.20/key/month.
- Residency: dedicated tenant in EU or CA for $9,000/month (12mo committed), or soft-residency via geo-routing at no base cost.
- HIPAA: we will waive the $8,000 onboarding fee if Mercury signs a 12-month reserved plan within 30 days. We will also provide a controls mapping one-pager.

Attached: Redwood_Compliance_AddOn_Pricing_v2.pdf; Mercury_MAL-Questionnaire_Responses.docx

Commercial ask: accept proposed pricing and DocuSign the compliance SOW within 10 business days to lock the promotional credits and BYOK discount. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/Signing/?s=abc123-example

Please let me know if you want a short call to walk through the line items.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_AddOn_Pricing_v2.pdf, Mercury_MAL-Questionnaire_Responses.docx]

From: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@mercuryhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@hcpsystems.com>, procurement@mercuryhealth.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated commercial: Mercury Health — compliance add-ons (proposal attached)

Jonas — thanks, this is helpful. A few follow-ups before we bring to commercial review:

1) KMS/HSM: We prefer a fixed per-key fee included in the SOW rather than ongoing variable pass-throughs. Can Redwood commit to a firm per-key price for the term of the SOW? We also need clear language on BYOK responsibilities and key-rotation process.
2) Audit log SLA: can you commit to export availability SLA (requested: 24h turnaround for delivery of requested historical exports)? Also please clarify restore/restore-testing costs.
3) HIPAA one-pager: appreciate the waiver; we still need a mapping to our SOC2/HIPAA matrix and an explicit list of controls Redwood will attest to.

If Redwood can confirm a firm per-key fee and the 24h export SLA, we will present this to our procurement committee next week. Also — you listed the dedicated residency at $9k/mo with 12mo commit; please confirm any lead time for region onboarding (timeline).

Thanks — Anita

--
Anita Sharma
Head of Procurement, Mercury Health
anita.sharma@mercuryhealth.com
[Attachment requested: HIPAA control mapping one-pager]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Sharma <anita.sharma@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated commercial: Mercury Health — compliance add-ons (proposal attached)

Hi Anita — appreciate the quick review. Confirming the following so you have exact language for your committee: 

- Fixed per-key fee: Redwood will include a fixed per-key fee of $0.25/key/month for the term of the SOW (12 months) if Mercury elects the BYOK/HSM passthrough option. This will be documented in Section 2.4 of the SOW.
- Audit log export SLA: Redwood commits to making export requests available within 24 hours for historical exports up to the 7yr archival tier. Restores beyond standard archival retrieval may incur a one-time restore fee (detailed in pricing attachment); we will include a clause that ETAs for large restores will be coordinated and that emergency restores are escalated via our 24x7 support.
- Dedicated residency lead time: once contract signed and 50% of first-month invoice received, we estimate a 6-week lead time for dedicated tenancy in EU (Frankfurt). We'll provide milestone updates during onboarding.
- HIPAA mapping: Kimberly is producing the one-pager and will attach it to the DocuSign SOW.

Next steps: I will upload a finalized SOW (DocuSign_Compliance_SOW.pdf) to the DocuSign link and send a short checklist for onboarding. If Mercury is ready, sign by Aug 11 to secure the promotional discounts.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/Signing/?s=abc123-example

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachments pending: DocuSign_Compliance_SOW.pdf]
